column1: # The verbs software commands the user with (Save, Install, Update, Allow,
# Confirm ...), one lemma per line, chosen by hand; read by
# into formant_slovenian.inc: for each verb the second person imperatives of
# Sloleks 3.1 (hand-accented) whose accent differs from the reading of the
# same spelling as the present (nadgrádi, nadgradí; namésti, namestí;
# posodôbi, posodobí), the pattern of Slovenski pravopis 2001 (gradíti grádi
# -íte, vršíti vŕši -íte, namestíti namésti -íte, dovolíti dovôli -íte).
# A verb whose imperative and present read alike (zaženi, prenesi, kopiraj)
# gets no entry. Only verbs that are commands in software belong here:
# at the head of a sentence of prose the spelling is mostly the present
# (SUK 1.1: sledi, živi, vodi, drži, cveti), so the class as a whole is not
# read so. A Slovenian listener's report of 2026-11-03 (posodobi, nadgradi,
# namesti, izvrši). Also a verb a listener asked to hear as the command at
